flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8790 then Make sure a goal map is showing (create one called 'Run a marathon' via the goal picker '+ New' if none exists).
Note the steps in the route list.
Click a milestone in the middle of the route and block it.
Verify the route list changes so the blocked milestone is no longer in it, or the app says no route is possible.
Get the steps in the route list and save it as {{route_steps}}.

remark: analyze: no goal map is showing
click: Clicking Launch Planner in the top navigation
click: Clicking New goal picker in the header
click: Clicking + New in the goal picker popover
wait: queued plan (2 steps): click "Run a marathon"; click "Create"
click: Clicking Create in the New goal dialog
wait: Waiting after creating the goal
click: Clicking 4 Begin taper milestone in the route list
click: PRIMARY: block it; role=button; text="Delete" | HINTS: container=selected Begin
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The steps in the route list are saved as {{route_steps}
assert: Verify the route list changes so the blocked milestone is no longer in it, or th

summary:
You asked to review the route steps and block a milestone in the middle of the route.
Since no goal map was initially displayed, a new goal named “Run a marathon” was created.
A middle milestone was blocked.
The route list then showed that no path to the goal was available, and there were no remaining actionable route steps.
